name: al-agentic-dev
description: Agentic AL/Business Central development: composable skills (al-steer, al-grill-adr, al-event-model, al-design, al-scope, al-refine, al-implement, al-refactor, al-mutate, al-second-opinion, al-research) with two persistent layers: repo-root memory (CONTEXT.md, docs/adr/, .out-of-scope/) and branch-scoped feature state (event-model.html + architecture.html + tasks.html). SKILLs express intent and rationale, not enumerated rules with skip conditions or slot prescriptions; disciplines (deletion test, two-adapter rule, R→P→W, ZOMBIES, replan triggers) state why they exist and the agent maps rationale to situation per feature. NEW in 0.18.0: Linear-style design system at references/design-system/ becomes the single source of truth for spec artifact visuals (gallery.html + three populated example pages + canonical CSS tokens, Inter Tight + Inter + JetBrains Mono, auto light/dark via prefers-color-scheme, mid-tone Mermaid palette). Per-feature aesthetic divergence is gone; class names, palette, typography, and component shape are prescribed centrally. html-spec-discipline.md rewritten as contracts + tokens summary + design-system pointer. Surgical-edit contracts on tasks.html unchanged. NEW in 0.17.0: /al-event-model settles the user-facing journey (Role / Action / Business Event / View / Status, Event Modeling lineage) before /al-design commits architecture. Optional per feature, pure-backend features skip it. /al-design reads event-model.html and settles AL-shape only; user-side picks no longer re-litigated inline. Branch creation shared between /al-event-model and /al-design (first per-feature skill to run creates the branch). BREAKING in 0.16.0: tasks.html surgical-edit contract collapses from six hooks to two (data-task + data-status only). Every other shape inside the task block is the writing skill's call per task; inconsistency across features is fine and expected. architecture.html has no surgical-edit contract at all. ADRs and CONTEXT.md stay markdown. Legacy markdown specs are frozen; new skills refuse to operate on them. No bilingual dispatch.
